title: Jets, Buccaneers can’t stop fighting in heated joint practice: ‘Not going to get punked’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets, Buccaneers can’t stop fighting in heated joint practice: ‘Not going to get punked’
sources.description: The longtime friendship of the opposing head coaches — Tampa Bay’s Todd Bowles was the secondary coach for the Jets when Glenn was still a cornerback in New York — was powerless to prevent repeated fights between their teams.
